name: Switch between four unique server models
description: Tabs replace the current model and present physically distinct systems rather than renaming a common enclosure.
steps: Verify eight H200 GPU packages in the 6U chassis
Verify a full-height rack with stacked tray bays
expected: All four tabs operate, each has a 3D model with different chassis proportions and hardware details, and its component inspector changes.

name: Collapse the sidebar and restore it
description: Give the 3D machine all available space without leaving an empty right sidebar.
expected: Sidebar disappears and 3D viewer fills the available width; the sidebar can be restored with details intact.

name: Enable fullscreen mode
description: Native browser fullscreen should be available from the 3D viewer.
steps: Observe the expanded viewer and active machine tabs
expected: The experience expands using browser fullscreen when permitted, with tabs, rotate and other useful controls still accessible, and exits successfully.

name: Use exploded view and model-specific guided steps
description: Four models each offer exploratory and guided decomposition rather than a static illustration.
steps: Select GB200 NVL72 and enter Step-by-step
expected: Components visibly separate and model-specific walkthrough steps change the assemblies and detail explanation; GB200 rack guide discusses compute trays, NVLink switches, coolant and power.

name: Inspect hardware and access official references on mobile
description: All machine tabs and detail controls should work on a narrow screen.
steps: Scroll to details and choose 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs
Hide sidebar and then show it
expected: The machine tab row fits on mobile, viewer and inspector are usable, sidebar can be toggled and official vendor links are accessible.
